# Top 10 Best Handbags: Luxury & Affordable Options 2026

A great handbag is both a practical necessity and a powerful style statement. We tested dozens of bags across price ranges and styles to compile this definitive guide to the best handbags of 2026.

## Quick Comparison Table

| Rank | Brand | Type | Price Range | Capacity | Rating |
|------|-------|------|-------------|----------|--------|
| 1 | Hermes Birkin | Luxury | $10,000+ | Medium | ★★★★★ |
| 2 | Chanel Classic Flap | Luxury | $8,000+ | Small | ★★★★★ |
| 3 | Longchamp Le Pliage | Affordable | $150 | Large | ★★★★☆ |
| 4 | Coach Tabby | Mid-range | $350 | Medium | ★★★★☆ |
| 5 | Polene NumeroUn | Designer | $250 | Medium | ★★★★☆ |

## Our Top Pick: Longchamp Le Pliage

The iconic French foldable bag that has been a staple since 1974. Lightweight nylon construction water-resistant and fits everything you need for daily commutes or weekend trips.

**Price:** From $150 | **Best for:** Everyday use and travel

## Final Verdict

For luxury investors the Hermes Birkin remains unmatched in resale value. For everyday practicality Longchamp Le Pliage offers unbeatable versatility at an accessible price point.
